code: body { background-color: #050505 !important; color: #fff; text-shadow: 0 0 10px #ff00ff, 0 0 20px #00ffff; overflow-x: hidden; } body::before { content: ''; position: fixed; top: -50px; left: 50%; width: 150px; height: 150px; margin-left: -75px; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle, #fff, #888); box-shadow: 0 0 50px 20px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4), 0 0 100px 40px rgba(0, 255, 255, 0.3), 0 0 150px 60px rgba(255, 0, 255, 0.3); background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, transparent, transparent 10px, rgba(0,0,0,0.3) 10px, rgba(0,0,0,0.3) 20px), repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, transparent, transparent 10px, rgba(0,0,0,0.3) 10px, rgba(0,0,0,0.3) 20px); animation: spinBall 4s linear infinite; z-index: 9999; pointer-events: none; } body::after { content: ''; position: fixed; bottom: 0; left: -50vw; right: -50vw; height: 60vh; background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,0,255,0.4) 2px, transparent 2px), linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(0,255,255,0.4) 2px, transparent 2px); background-size: 60px 60px; transform: perspective(600px) rotateX(70deg); transform-origin: bottom; animation: floorPulse 0.4s infinite alternate; z-index: -1; pointer-events: none; } @keyframes spinBall { 0% { transform: rotate(0deg); } 100% { transform: rotate(360deg); } } @keyframes floorPulse { 0% { filter: hue-rotate(0deg) brightness(1); background-position: 0 0; } 100% { filter: hue-rotate(90deg) brightness(1.8); background-position: 30px 30px; } }
